name: Custom Shape 2-Layer Wooden Hanging Sign With Charms
description:
KEY FEATURES

 

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality wood, featuring a layered wooden sign design for a dimensional and eye-catching appearance. The hanging charms are also made of wood with a thickness of 3 mm. Each charm is securely connected with **black or silver metal hanging chains**, metal circular rings, and jump rings.

 

  • Sizes and Dimensions:

📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Designed with high-quality printing for sharp, clear, and vivid details.
       +)Wooden Sign Layer 1: 2-sided printing.
       +)Wooden Sign Layer 2:1-sided printing.
       +)Charms Row 1 & Row 2 – Layer 1: 2-sided printing.
       +)Charms Row 1 & Row 2 – Layer 2: 1-sided printing.
    - The layered construction creates a beautiful dimensional effect, while the detailed printing ensures the design looks attractive from different viewing angles.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - This personalized hanging wooden sign is perfect for Christmas and holiday decoration. The festive design can be displayed on walls, doors, windows, fireplaces, Christmas trees, or other indoor spaces. The hanging charms add a fun and personalized touch, making each piece a meaningful decoration for the holiday season.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Christmas:
    - A thoughtful and personalized gift for family, friends, couples, or colleagues.
    - Perfect for Christmas, housewarming celebrations, family gatherings, and holiday gift exchanges.
    - A charming keepsake that adds warmth, festive spirit, and a personal touch to any home décor.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
